LESSON: SPELLING INSTRUCTION BE ABLE TO:

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: LITERACY ACTIVITIES
Strand: WRITING
Topic 3.2: Spelling instruction be able to:

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Spelling instruction be able to:. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. use a range of spelling  Learners practice sorting words according to strategies to correct given patterns. misspelled words  Learners use reinforcement activities to relate
2. apply rules of spelling patterns to themes i.e.(sing the song avocado, in writing papaya, banana x2 fruits are life)

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

• Spelling instruction be able to: makes your writing clear so others can read it easily.

• Look at the model your teacher shows. Notice shape, order, and spacing.

• Practise slowly first, then build neat speed.

• Check your work: Did you spell carefully? Did you use correct marks?

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Copy three model sentences neatly, leaving finger spaces between words.

Example 2: Spell five lesson words aloud, then write them without looking.

Example 3: Fix this sentence by adding capital letters and a full stop: “amina went to kisumu”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Write five neat sentences about your school using words from this topic.
2. Exchange books with a friend and check spelling or punctuation together.
3. Rewrite one messy sentence so it is clear and correct.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Complete a short guided paragraph in your exercise book.
2. List eight words from this topic and practise spelling them with a parent.
3. Write a short note to a friend using correct punctuation.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Learners practice sorting words according to strategies to correct given patterns. misspelled words
2. Learners use reinforcement activities to relate b) apply rules of spelling patterns to themes i.e.(sing the song avocado, in writing papaya, banana x2 fruits are life) c) appreciate the
3. Learners engage in spelling games e.g. forming importance of accurate words from letter cut outs, scrabble, spelling spelling in texts relay
4. Learners brainstorm on new words learned and practice spelling them in writing(punctuation, accurate spelling, letter formation, and spacing)

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Neat writing helps the reader.
2. Check spelling and punctuation before you finish.
3. Practice a little every day.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
